title: LLM weight gateway: smart validation, variant heuristics, and pin recommendation engine
creator: Asha Khanna
description: Build a lightweight, policy-driven weight gateway that performs deterministic provenance checks, license & TOU validation, fast artifact compatibility probes, and produces an initial set of candidate runtime variants along with a confidence-scored pin recommendation. The gateway should integrate into the existing intake pipeline but add: (1) fast safety and license gating to block disallowed weights early; (2) a lightweight binary conversion probe that verifies runtime compatibility without full conversion; (3) variant scoring heuristics (quantization suitability, memory footprint estimate, token-latency profile) to create 2-3 candidate pins; and (4) a pin confidence metric that downstream pipelines (profiling/orbit) can use to prioritize full profiling. Goal: reduce time-to-first-pin for community weights by 60% while keeping false-positive pin rate under 5%.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway rejects weights with incompatible license or explicit TOU violation and emits a human-readable failure reason
Binary probe can detect major format mismatches (tensor layout, dtype mismatch) with >95% precision in under 90s on a small sample slice
Variant heuristics emit at least 1 safe pin and up to 3 ranked candidate pins with a confidence_score (0.0-1.0)
Pin confidence correlates with full profiling success: top-1 pin leads to successful profiling in >= 92% of trial cases in the staging harness
Telemetry: gateway emits standardized events (ingest.received, ingest.license_fail, probe.compat_ok, pin.recommendation) and is visible in the onboarding dashboard
comments: 2025-02-14 - Asha Khanna: RFC posted. Proposed pipeline: license -> provenance -> fast-binary-probe -> heuristic-scorer -> publish-candidates. Requested feedback on acceptable probe timeout budget (90s) and confidence thresholds.

2025-02-18 - Marco Ruiz: Spike results added to Drive. Fast probe using 3-sample forward pass detects dtype/layout mismatches reliably; however, quantization suitability heuristic needs more features (per-layer entropy estimate).

2025-02-22 - Priya Menon (Security): Reviewed license gating matrix. Added explicit denial for models with commercial-only clauses; recommended storing license manifests and signing artifacts. Security review flagged KMS integration for signature verification.

2025-02-26 - Marco Ruiz: Implemented initial heuristic: (memory_est / gpu_mem) baseline, quant_score from symmetric weight histograms, and latency_est from micro-benchmarks. Running staging sweep on 48 community weights.
2025-03-01 - Design review (Evan Chen): Request clearer UI messages for failed licenses and a small explainer for pin confidence on the Console. Added small UX ticket PM-412 for message copy.

2025-03-04 - QA (Lena Ortiz): Smoke harness hit an edge-case: model with sharded weights where manifest did not list all shards. Gateway now verifies shard manifests and rejects incomplete uploads with guidance to the uploader.
implementation_notes: We decided to keep the gateway stateless and emit signed provenance events to the intake topic. Trade-off: stateless simplifies autoscaling but requires downstream idempotent processors for retries. For the fast probe we use a deterministic 128-token slice and seeded RNG for layer sampling to make results reproducible. Pin heuristic intentionally conservative: prefer safe higher-memory pins over aggressive quantized pins for first-pass recommendations.
